title: CB3D14 cable sag / Ernst modulus + CB3D15 W>0 empty-cable state vs ANSYS 18.0
description: Single CABLE element: E=195 GPa, A=0.006 m2, LH=100 m, W=462.051 N/m. FEM closed form fem_3d.hpp::cableTensionFromChord + fem_3d_nl.hpp::cableErnstModulus; ANSYS 80-segment LINK180 chain with horizontal-uniform nodal self weight, NLGEOM,ON, INISTATE,EPEL and a 0.20 m sine-perturbed straight initial geometry. 7 jobs (5-point L0 sweep, W=0 rod baseline, W/2 low-weight). Ernst tangent is verified by finite difference of ANSYS H over the L0 sweep. CB3D15 confirms that W>0 removes the degenerate empty-cable stage (H >> 100 N, sag > 0).

derived_rules.H: mean over segments of T_k*|dx_k|/L_k (x = x_init + UX)
derived_rules.f: z_first - min(z), z = z_init + UZ, z_init=-amp*sin(pi*k/N)
derived_rules.ansys_fd: central difference of ANSYS H over the L0 sweep

bridge.description: W>0 gives a real catenary empty-cable state; W=0 (CB3D13) degenerates to the 100 N bisection floor
